description: Every object in Relic Revival Run carries the memory of the people who made it, and every one of them is in trouble: grime on a Maya stela, salts in Portuguese azulejos, insects in a Paracas textile, bronze disease on a Chola bronze. Choose the right treatment before you reach each spot (a poultice draws out salts, an anoxic bag treats insects, a solvent gel lifts an old repair), reveal hidden damage with the UV lamp and photograph it before you treat it. Damage arrives on the beat of each culture's own soundtrack, each culture after Mexico adds its own twist, and a final careful restoration ends each run. Restored artifacts go on show in the museum with the conservation notes you have learned. A remake of Studio Jojo's 2023 jam game, made for a jam against the illicit traffic of cultural property.
summary: Run through twelve cultures as an animal art restorer and match the right conservation tool to each kind of damage, on the beat.
